description: merge.md names its Advanced-credential read privilege 'Query Select' while nest.md (and 15 other read-only pages) name the structurally equivalent privilege 'Query Read' - the same underlying access grant, possibly named two different ways across sibling pages. Not yet resolved as the same or genuinely different privileges: reconciliation promoted privilege:capella-advanced-access-query-read (16-file recurrence) and left the single-occurrence privilege:capella-advanced-access-query-select at the extraction layer only, rather than merging the two without textual evidence they're identical, or promoting a 1-file mint on the strength of a naming coincidence.
